prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. The picture contains itself: the open furnace door at the centre shows, inside its fire, the same basement room again, smaller, with its own open furnace door, which holds the room again, smaller and smaller, spiralling inwards forever. A tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache stands beside the furnace holding a coal shovel, and a smaller copy of him stands at every level of the spiral. A realistic 1920s basement: riveted pipes, brass gauges, a heap of coal. Light: only the fire; the rest in deep shadow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
